recipes.title: Shakshuka
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and diced bell pepper until very soft, about 7 minutes.
Add minced garlic, cumin, and paprika. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Make 6 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook on low heat for 6-8 minutes until the egg whites are set but yolks remain slightly runny.
Sprinkle crumbled feta and fresh cilantro over the top. Serve immediately from the skillet.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Soft Figs
instructions: Divide Greek yogurt between two bowls.
Top each bowl with quartered soft figs.
Drizzle honey generously over the yogurt and figs.
Dust with ground cinnamon and scatter sunflower seeds on top if desired.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Egg Scramble with Spinach and Feta
instructions: Whisk the eggs with oregano, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add baby spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes until wilted.
Add sun-dried tomatoes and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in the egg mixture and gently stir with a spatula, forming soft curds.
When the eggs are almost set but still slightly moist, remove from heat and fold in crumbled feta.
Serve immediately on warm plates.

recipes.title: Turkish Menemen
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Sauté diced green peppers for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add diced tomatoes, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes break down into a thick sauce.
Crack eggs directly into the sauce, gently stirring to create soft scrambled curds mixed throughout.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until eggs are just set but still creamy.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm with soft bread.

recipes.title: Savory Mediterranean Oatmeal with Soft Egg
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a saucepan. Stir in rolled oats and reduce heat to medium-low.
Cook oats for 5 minutes, stirring often, until creamy and thick.
In a small skillet, heat olive oil and quickly wilt the baby spinach with cherry tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 3-4 minutes until whites are set.
Divide savory oatmeal between bowls, top with wilted spinach and tomatoes, grated Parmesan, and a poached egg.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Ricotta and Herb Stuffed Soft Crepes
instructions: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, and a pinch of salt until smooth. Let batter rest 5 minutes.
Heat a lightly greased non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour about 3 tablespoons batter, swirl to coat, and cook 1-2 minutes per side.
Repeat to make 8 thin crepes.
In a bowl, combine ricotta, basil, dill, and lemon zest.
Spread 2 tablespoons of the ricotta mixture on each crepe and fold into quarters.
Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Frittata with Zucchini and Roasted Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Heat olive oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Sauté red onion and zucchini for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add roasted red peppers and stir for 1 minute.
Whisk eggs with oregano, salt, and pepper. Pour over the vegetables in the skillet.
Cook on stovetop for 3 minutes without stirring until edges begin to set.
Scatter feta on top and transfer to the oven. Bake 12-15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Let rest 3 minutes before slicing into wedges.

recipes.title: Labneh Toast with Olive Oil and Za'atar
instructions: Lightly toast the soft bread slices until just warm but still pliable.
Spread a generous layer of labneh on each slice.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle with za'atar.
Top with halved cherry tomatoes and cucumber slices if desired.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Soft Polenta with Poached Eggs and Tomato Sauce
instructions: Bring water to a boil with salt. Slowly whisk in polenta, reduce heat to low.
Cook polenta for 15-20 minutes, stirring frequently, until thick and creamy.
Stir in Parmesan and butter until melted and smooth.
Meanwhile, warm marinara sauce in a small saucepan.
Poach eggs in simmering water for 3-4 minutes.
Divide creamy polenta among bowls, spoon marinara sauce over the top, and place a poached egg on each.
Garnish with basil leaves.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Breakfast Strata
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Spread cubed soft bread in the baking dish.
Layer spinach, sun-dried tomatoes, olives, and feta over the bread.
Whisk eggs, milk, oregano, salt, and pepper. Pour evenly over the bread mixture.
Press down gently so bread absorbs the custard. Let sit 10 minutes.
Bake 35-40 minutes until puffed, golden, and set in the center.
Let cool 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Whipped Feta and Roasted Tomato Egg Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Blend feta and cream cheese in a food processor until smooth and whipped.
Divide whipped feta among 4 small ramekins, spreading along the bottom and sides.
Toss cherry tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and thyme. Nestle into the ramekins.
Crack an egg into each ramekin on top of the tomatoes and cheese.
Season with pepper and bake 15-18 minutes until egg whites are set.
Let cool 2 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Warm Semolina Porridge with Date Syrup and Tahini
instructions: Bring oat milk and a pinch of salt to a gentle simmer in a saucepan.
Slowly whisk in semolina, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Cook over low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Stir in cinnamon.
Divide between bowls, drizzle with date syrup and tahini.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Soft Pita Wraps with Grilled Chicken and Tzatziki
instructions: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and salt for at least 10 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear chicken over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through (165°F internal).
Let chicken rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Make tzatziki: combine Greek yogurt, grated cucumber (squeezed dry), dill, and a pinch of salt.
Warm pita bread until soft and pliable.
Fill each pita with sliced chicken, lettuce, tomato, and generous tzatziki.
Roll up and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Spanakopita (Soft Flaky Version)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Sauté onion in 1 tablespoon olive oil until soft, about 5 minutes. Add spinach and cook until wilted. Let cool and squeeze out excess liquid.
In a large bowl, combine spinach mixture with feta, ricotta, eggs, scallions, dill, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Mix olive oil and melted butter together. Brush a 9x13 baking dish with the mixture.
Layer 6 sheets of phyllo in the dish, brushing each generously with the oil-butter mixture. Keep remaining phyllo covered with a damp towel.
Spread the spinach filling evenly over the phyllo layers.
Layer remaining 6 sheets on top, brushing each with the oil-butter mixture.
Score the top layers into squares or diamonds with a sharp knife.
Bake 30-35 minutes until golden and the phyllo layers are soft and flaky.
Let cool 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Stuffed Bell Peppers with Rice and Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Brown ground turkey with garlic, oregano, and cumin for 5-6 minutes.
Stir in half the diced tomatoes, cooked rice, salt, and pepper.
Stuff each pepper with the turkey-rice mixture and place upright in a baking dish.
Pour remaining diced tomatoes around the peppers in the dish.
Cover with foil and bake 35-40 minutes until peppers are very tender.
Uncover, top with feta and parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan White Bean and Tomato Stew
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add cannellini beans, diced tomatoes, sun-dried tomatoes, vegetable broth, basil, and red pepper flakes.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes.
Use a potato masher to lightly crush about a third of the beans to thicken the stew.
Stir in spinach and cook 2-3 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve in bowls with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Greek-Style Orzo Salad with Soft Vegetables
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions until tender. Drain and rinse with cool water.
Whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add cooked orzo, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, olives, and red onion. Toss to combine.
Fold in crumbled feta gently.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.

recipes.title: Warm Lentil and Roasted Vegetable Bowl
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cook lentils in salted water for 20-25 minutes until tender. Drain.
Toss sweet potato, zucchini, and bell pepper with 2 tablespoons olive oil and cumin. Spread on a baking sheet.
Roast vegetables for 25 minutes until tender and lightly caramelized.
Make dressing: whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic, remaining olive oil, and 2 tablespoons water.
Combine lentils and roasted vegetables in bowls. Drizzle with tahini dressing.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Eggplant and Chickpea Stew with Soft Flatbread
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Cook eggplant cubes for 5-6 minutes until softened and golden.
Add onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, cumin, cinnamon, and salt.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 20 minutes until eggplant is meltingly soft.
Stir in fresh parsley.
Serve warm with soft flatbread for dipping.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Tuna Melt on Soft Roll

ingredients.displayName: Canned Tuna in Olive Oil, drained

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine drained tuna, olives, sun-dried tomatoes, red onion, capers, and lemon juice.
Split soft rolls and divide the tuna mixture between them.
Top each with sliced mozzarella.
Bake 6-8 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Add fresh basil leaves and serve warm.

recipes.title: Creamy Greek Chicken and Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium-high heat.
Brown chicken thighs on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion until soft, 4 minutes. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add rice and stir for 1 minute. Pour in broth, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Return chicken to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer 18-20 minutes until rice is tender.
Fold in spinach until wilted, top with feta, and serve.

recipes.title: Soft Falafel Bowl with Tahini Sauce
instructions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cilantro, cumin, coriander, flour, and 0.5 tsp salt in a food processor until a coarse paste forms. Do not over-process.
Shape into small patties and refrigerate 15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Pan-fry falafel 3-4 minutes per side until golden on the outside and soft inside.
Make tahini sauce: whisk tahini, lemon juice, remaining salt, and 3 tablespoons water until smooth.
Assemble bowls with rice, falafel patties, diced cucumber and tomato.
Drizzle generously with tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Roasted Red Pepper and Goat Cheese Pasta
instructions: Cook penne according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Blend roasted red peppers, goat cheese, garlic, olive oil, and cream until smooth.
Pour the sauce into a large skillet over medium-low heat. Warm gently for 2 minutes.
Add drained pasta and toss, adding reserved pasta water as needed for silky consistency.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh basil and serve.

recipes.title: Warm Couscous with Roasted Vegetables and Lemon Yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss zucchini, eggplant, and cherry tomatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, cumin, and salt on a baking sheet.
Roast 20 minutes until vegetables are very tender.
Pour hot broth over couscous in a bowl, cover, and let sit 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and drizzle with remaining olive oil.
Mix Greek yogurt with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Serve couscous topped with roasted vegetables, dollops of lemon yogurt, and fresh mint.

recipes.title: Italian Wedding Soup (Soft Meatballs)

ingredients.displayName: Acini di Pepe or Small Pasta

instructions: Combine ground chicken, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, egg, garlic, salt, and pepper. Roll into 1-inch meatballs.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add meatballs and cook 5 minutes.
Add small pasta and cook another 8-10 minutes until pasta is tender and meatballs are cooked through.
Stir in escarole or spinach and cook 2 minutes until wilted.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with extra Parmesan.

recipes.title: Braised Lamb with Orzo
instructions: Season lamb generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear lamb in batches until deeply browned on all sides, about 8 minutes total. Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Sauté onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in red wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Cook until wine reduces by half.
Add crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, and oregano. Return lamb to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer. Cover and cook for 1.5 hours until lamb is fork-tender.
Remove cinnamon stick and bay leaves. Stir in orzo.
Cover and cook an additional 15-18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until orzo is tender and has absorbed most of the liquid.
The dish should be thick and stew-like. Garnish with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Risotto Milanese
instructions: Steep saffron threads in 0.5 cup of warm broth for 5 minutes.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a wide heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Sauté onion for 4-5 minutes until translucent.
Add arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until edges turn translucent.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the saffron broth. Begin adding remaining warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently, waiting until each addition is mostly absorbed before adding the next.
Continue for 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy and tender with a slight bite.
Remove from heat. Stir in remaining butter and Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper.
Let rest 2 minutes, then serve immediately. The risotto should flow slowly when spooned onto a plate.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Soak dried porcini in 1 cup hot water for 10 minutes. Strain and reserve soaking liquid. Chop porcini.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large pan. Sauté sliced fresh mushrooms over high heat until golden and tender, about 6 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add remaining olive oil. Sauté onion for 4 minutes until soft. Add garlic and chopped porcini, cook 1 minute.
Add arborio rice and stir 2 minutes. Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Add porcini soaking liquid. Begin adding warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently.
Continue for 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy.
Return sautéed mushrooms to the risotto. Stir in remaining butter, Parmesan, and thyme.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Seafood Risotto
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a pan. Quickly sear shrimp and calamari for 2 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté shallots in remaining olive oil for 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add rice and stir 2 minutes. Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Add cherry tomatoes. Begin adding warm stock one ladle at a time, stirring frequently.
After 12 minutes, add mussels. Continue adding stock and cooking for another 6-8 minutes until rice is creamy and mussels have opened (discard any that remain closed).
Return shrimp and calamari to the risotto. Stir in butter, lemon juice, and parsley.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Lemon and Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Spread minced garlic over each fillet. Season with salt and pepper.
Top with fresh dill, parsley, and capers. Lay lemon slices over the fish.
Bake 15-18 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork and reaches 145°F internal temperature.
Let rest 2 minutes. Serve with additional lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata with Soft Linguine
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions until tender. Drain and keep warm.
Season chicken cutlets with salt and pepper, then dredge lightly in flour.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove to a plate.
In the same skillet, add broth and lemon juice. Scrape up browned bits and simmer 3 minutes.
Add capers and remaining butter. Swirl until butter melts and sauce thickens slightly.
Return chicken to the pan. Spoon sauce over the chicken.
Serve chicken and sauce over linguine, garnished with parsley.

recipes.title: Slow-Braised Chicken Thighs with Olives and Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear chicken skin-side down for 5 minutes until golden. Flip and sear 2 more minutes. Remove.
Sauté onion and garlic in the drippings for 3 minutes.
Pour in wine and scrape up browned bits. Cook 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, olives, and thyme. Nestle chicken back in, skin-side up.
Cover and braise in the oven for 40-45 minutes until chicken is very tender and falling off the bone.
Serve chicken with the braising sauce spooned over the top.

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Cook angel hair pasta until just tender. Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Sauté shrimp 2 minutes per side until pink. Remove.
Add butter and garlic to the skillet. Cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in wine and cook 2 minutes until reduced by half.
Stir in cream, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Simmer 2 minutes.
Toss in pasta, Parmesan, and red pepper flakes. Add pasta water as needed for silky sauce.
Return shrimp to the pan, toss gently, and garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan (Melanzane alla Parmigiana)
instructions: Salt eggplant slices and let sit 20 minutes to draw out moisture. Pat dry.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Set up a breading station: flour, beaten eggs, then breadcrumbs. Coat each eggplant slice.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Pan-fry eggplant slices 2-3 minutes per side until tender and golden. Drain on paper towels.
Spread 1 cup marinara in a 9x13 baking dish. Layer half the eggplant, half the remaining sauce, half the mozzarella, and some Parmesan.
Repeat layers. Top with remaining Parmesan.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.
Let rest 10 minutes. Garnish with basil and serve.

recipes.title: Greek Moussaka
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Brush eggplant slices with olive oil and roast on a baking sheet for 20 minutes until tender.
Brown ground lamb in a skillet. Add onion and garlic, cook 5 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes, wine, cinnamon, oregano, salt, and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes until thick.

Make béchamel: Melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour and cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in milk. Cook until thick, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and whisk in egg yolks, nutmeg, and half the Parmesan.
Layer roasted eggplant in a 9x13 dish, then meat sauce, then remaining eggplant.
Pour béchamel over the top. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan.
Bake 40-45 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Let rest 15 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Cod en Papillote
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut 4 large pieces of parchment paper.
Place a bed of zucchini slices in the center of each parchment sheet.
Place a cod fillet on each bed of zucchini. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide cherry tomatoes and olives among the packets. Add lemon slices and herbs.
Drizzle each with olive oil. Fold parchment to create sealed packets.
Place on a baking sheet and bake 15-18 minutes until fish flakes easily.
Carefully open packets at the table to release the aromatic steam.

recipes.title: Baked Mediterranean Chicken with Artichokes and Tomatoes

ingredients.displayName: Canned Artichoke Hearts, drained and quartered

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Season chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, and paprika.
Toss artichoke hearts, cherry tomatoes, olives, and garlic with 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large baking dish.
Nestle chicken among the vegetables. Drizzle with remaining olive oil and lemon juice.
Bake 30-35 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F and vegetables are tender.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Gnocchi
instructions: Cook gnocchi according to package directions until they float. Drain.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Add cream, basil, and red pepper flakes. Simmer 3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Add cooked gnocchi and Parmesan. Toss gently until coated.
Season with salt and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Herb-Crusted Tilapia with Warm Tomato Compote
instructions: Season tilapia with salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
Mix parsley, dill, and garlic. Press herb mixture onto the top of each fillet.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook fish herb-side down for 3 minutes, flip gently, and cook 3 more minutes.
Remove fish. In the same skillet, add remaining olive oil and sauté tomatoes and capers for 3-4 minutes until tomatoes soften into a warm compote.
Add remaining lemon juice to the compote.
Serve tilapia over the warm tomato compote.

recipes.title: One-Pot Mediterranean Beef and Vegetable Stew
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over high heat. Sear beef in batches until browned. Remove.
Reduce heat to medium. Sauté onion for 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in red wine and scrape up browned bits. Cook 2 minutes.
Return beef and add crushed tomatoes, broth, oregano, and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Add potatoes, cover and cook 20 minutes more.
Add zucchini and cook uncovered 15 minutes until all vegetables are very tender.
Remove bay leaves, garnish with parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Spinach and Artichoke Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook pasta shells until just al dente. Drain and cool.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine ricotta, wilted spinach, artichoke hearts, half the mozzarella, Parmesan, egg, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread 1 cup marinara in a 9x13 baking dish.
Fill each shell with a generous tablespoon of the ricotta mixture. Arrange in the dish.
Pour remaining sauce over the shells. Top with remaining mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 5 more minutes until cheese is bubbly.
Garnish with basil and serve.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Baked White Fish with Fennel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss sliced fennel and cherry tomatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper in a baking dish.
Roast vegetables for 10 minutes until fennel begins to soften.
Nestle fish fillets among the vegetables. Drizzle with remaining olive oil, lemon juice, and wine.
Return to oven and bake 12-15 minutes until fish flakes easily.
Garnish with parsley and serve with the roasted vegetables and pan juices.

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta with Yogurt Sauce over Rice
instructions: Combine lamb, grated onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, parsley, mint, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Shape into oval kofta about 3 inches long.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook kofta 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through and tender.
Make yogurt sauce: mix Greek yogurt, lemon juice, remaining mint, and a pinch of salt.
Serve kofta over warm rice with generous spoonfuls of yogurt sauce.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup (Avgolemono)
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot. Add chicken breast, reduce heat, and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken and shred into small pieces.
Return broth to a simmer. Add rice and cook 15 minutes until very tender.
In a bowl, whisk eggs and lemon juice vigorously until frothy.
Slowly ladle 2 cups of hot broth into the egg-lemon mixture, whisking constantly to temper the eggs (this prevents curdling).
Pour the tempered mixture back into the pot, stirring continuously. Cook on low heat for 2-3 minutes until the soup thickens slightly. Do not boil.
Return shredded chicken to the soup. Add lemon zest, salt, and white pepper.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh dill.

recipes.title: Greek Egg Lemon Soup (Vegetarian Avgolemono)
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to a boil. Add orzo and cook until very tender, about 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to very low.
Whisk eggs and lemon juice together in a bowl until frothy.
Slowly ladle 1.5 cups of hot broth into the egg-lemon mixture, whisking constantly.
Pour the tempered mixture back into the pot, stirring gently. Do not let it boil.
Stir in butter, lemon zest, salt, and white pepper.
Serve in warm bowls garnished with fresh dill. The soup should be velvety and creamy.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Lentil Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, cumin, and turmeric. Cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add red lentils, vegetable broth, and diced tomatoes. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 25-30 minutes until lentils are completely broken down and soft.
For a creamier texture, use an immersion blender to partially purée the soup.
Stir in spinach (if using) and cook until wilted.
Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Serve drizzled with olive oil.

recipes.title: Pasta e Fagioli
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook pancetta until lightly rendered, about 3 minutes.
Add onion, celery, and garlic. Sauté 5 minutes until softened.
Add crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, 1 can of beans (whole), oregano, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer.
Mash the second can of beans with a fork and add them to thicken the soup.
Add ditalini pasta and cook 10-12 minutes until pasta is tender.
Season with salt and pepper. Remove bay leaf.
Serve topped with Parmesan and parsley.

recipes.title: Creamy Roasted Red Pepper Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Sauté onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and smoked paprika. Cook 1 minute.
Add roasted red peppers and vegetable broth. Bring to a simmer and cook 15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to purée until completely smooth.
Stir in heavy cream, salt, and pepper.
Serve garnished with basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Moroccan-Spiced Chickpea and Sweet Potato Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Sauté onion 5 minutes, then add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add cumin, cinnamon, and turmeric. Stir 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes until sweet potatoes are very tender.
Partially blend with an immersion blender for a thick, creamy texture (leave some chunks).
Stir in lemon juice and salt. Serve topped with cilantro.

recipes.title: Tuscan Tomato and Bread Soup (Pappa al Pomodoro)

ingredients.displayName: Day-Old Soft Bread, torn into pieces

instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a pot. Gently cook garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add torn bread and broth. Stir well. Simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the bread breaks down completely and the soup becomes thick and porridge-like.
Tear in most of the basil and stir.
Serve drizzled with remaining olive oil and topped with basil leaves.

recipes.title: Silky Zucchini and Leek Soup with Herbs

ingredients.displayName: Leek, white and light green parts, sliced

instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot. Sauté leeks for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and zucchini. Cook 3 minutes.
Pour in broth, bring to a boil, then simmer 12-15 minutes until zucchini is very tender.
Add basil and mint. Blend with an immersion blender until completely silky smooth.
Stir in lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Serve with a swirl of Greek yogurt and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Hummus
instructions: Process tahini and lemon juice in a food processor for 1 minute until thick and whipped.
Add garlic, cumin, and salt. Process 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas and process 1 minute. Scrape sides.
With the processor running, drizzle in olive oil and ice water. Process 2-3 minutes until extremely smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust lemon juice and salt.
Serve in a shallow bowl, swirled with a spoon, drizzled with olive oil, and sprinkled with paprika.

recipes.title: Baba Ganoush
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Pierce eggplants several times with a fork.
Place eggplants directly on oven rack (with a tray below to catch drips). Roast 35-40 minutes until completely collapsed and very soft.
Let cool slightly. Cut in half and scoop the smoky flesh into a colander. Let drain 5 minutes.
Transfer eggplant flesh to a food processor with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, and salt.
Pulse until smooth but still with some texture.
Spread on a plate, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with smoked paprika and parsley.
Serve with warm soft pita bread.

recipes.title: Whipped Feta Dip with Roasted Garlic
instructions: Slice the top off the garlic head, drizzle with a little olive oil, wrap in foil, and roast at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until soft and golden.
Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves from their skins.
Combine feta, cream cheese, roasted garlic, olive oil, and lemon juice in a food processor.
Process 2-3 minutes until completely smooth and whipped.
Transfer to a bowl, garnish with dill and a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve with warm soft pita or soft vegetables.

recipes.title: Tzatziki Dip

ingredients.displayName: English Cucumber, grated and squeezed dry

instructions: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out as much liquid as possible using a clean towel or cheesecloth.
Combine Greek yogurt, squeezed cucumber, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, dill, and salt in a bowl.
Stir well and taste for seasoning.
Refrigerate at least 30 minutes to let flavors meld.
Serve drizzled with olive oil alongside soft pita or cooked vegetables.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Marinated Roasted Peppers
instructions: Roast whole peppers under a broiler, turning occasionally, until charred on all sides, about 15-20 minutes.
Place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and steam 10 minutes.
Peel, seed, and slice peppers into strips.
Toss with olive oil, garlic, vinegar, basil, oregano, and salt.
Let marinate at least 30 minutes at room temperature.
Serve as an appetizer or alongside soft bread and cheese.

recipes.title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes with Olive Oil and Herbs

ingredients.displayName: Yukon Gold Potatoes, peeled and cubed

instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15-18 minutes until very tender. Drain well.
Warm olive oil and garlic gently in a small pan for 2 minutes (do not brown).
Mash potatoes with the garlic olive oil and warm milk until smooth and creamy.
Stir in rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Serve topped with chives and an extra drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Sautéed Lemony Green Beans with Garlic
instructions: Blanch green beans in boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Drain and pat dry.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add green beans and sauté 4-5 minutes until tender and lightly blistered.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook 1 minute.
Remove from heat. Toss with lemon juice, lemon zest, and salt.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Braised Greens with Garlic and Olive Oil

ingredients.displayName: Swiss Chard or Kale, stems removed, chopped

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes. Cook 1 minute until garlic is fragrant.
Add chopped greens in batches, tossing with tongs as they wilt.
Add 2 tablespoons water, cover, and cook 8-10 minutes until greens are very tender.
Season with salt and lemon juice.
Drizzle with additional olive oil before serving.

recipes.title: Soft Mediterranean Cucumber and Tomato Salad
instructions: Combine cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over vegetables and toss gently.
Let sit 10 minutes at room temperature to allow flavors to meld.
Serve as a refreshing side dish.

recipes.title: Slow-Roasted Cherry Tomatoes with Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C).
Spread cherry tomatoes on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Toss with olive oil, garlic, thyme, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Roast 40-45 minutes until tomatoes are very soft, collapsed, and intensely sweet.
Drizzle with balsamic vinegar.
Serve warm as a side dish, over pasta, or spooned onto soft bread.

recipes.title: Creamy Polenta with Parmesan
instructions: Bring water and milk to a boil with salt.
Slowly whisk in polenta in a thin stream, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat to very low. Cook 20-25 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the polenta is thick, creamy, and pulls away from the sides of the pot.
Remove from heat. Stir in butter, Parmesan, olive oil, and pepper.
Serve immediately while hot and flowing. The polenta should be the consistency of thick porridge.
